selection: Units: a match seed (all its matches on every build and both first movers) and a case script (its cases on every build).
Scripts with a variant pair (-human/-ai, or -v1/-v2): one variant to discovery, the other to held-out (disjoint variants). Single-variant scripts go wholly to one partition.
Seeds (seedAssignment, D93): the 12 frozen seeds are ordered by sha256(salt:seed:<seed>); the first 4 go to held-out, the other 8 to discovery (disjoint seeds). Seeds are not optimized for coverage.

Script candidates are enumerated in an order fixed by the salt and scored lexicographically: (1) rules covered in both partitions, (2) the smaller of the two partition coverage counts, (3) closeness of the discovery share of observations (cases + matches) to discoveryTarget, (4) enumeration order.

Hard constraints (constraints): at least 12 seeds, at least 4 held-out seeds, and a distinct matrix-shield variant in each partition (D96). A violated constraint fails the partition with the reason; nothing is relaxed.
Coverage: gaps.ts semantics over the frozen coverage map (every pattern of a rule on every build). Only engine-reported events are used; agent output is never an input.
notes: Frozen in the same commit as p7-generation-1, before any P7 observation was generated.
recordMatchSeeds: eval/ maps each neutral match id to its seed, so held-out replication is counted in seed groups (D90).
